claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantSenseOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Magic grants the caster a persistent magical sense (detect magic within 30 ft) while concentrating. The ongoing_effect family is structurally correct, but OngoingOperation = RollModifierOperation | DamageOnHitOperation — neither covers a sense-granting effect. The v4 atom grant_sense exists in the taxonomy; it needs an OngoingOperation variant to expose it on the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.minutes with ritual flag
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Detect Magic can be cast as a Ritual (10-minute cast, no slot expended). The existing CastingTime minutes variant already supports the ritual flag (ritual: boolean). This is already present in the surface — no new variant needed. Noted here for completeness.
